title: Tower Drop
short_description: Stack blocks with precision — keep the tower balanced
long_description:
Tower Drop is a self-contained single-page HTML5 game from the Omega Games library. Stack blocks with precision. Missed overhangs get trimmed - keep it balanced!

Controls: tap/click. No installation, no account, no external network calls — the whole game is one HTML file that runs entirely in the browser tab it's loaded in.

It's an action/reflex title: quick decisions and quick hands matter more than planning.

Built for embedding: the page has no iframe-blocking headers, so it drops straight into a portal frame at any size. Session length is short (seconds to a few minutes per round), which fits browsing/portal traffic patterns rather than a long-form download.

Source id: tower_drop. Part of a 21-title batch of small HTML5 games being submitted from the same library — if you like this one, the others share the same lightweight, dependency-free build.
cover_capture_method: playwright chromium headless, local file:// build
